title: Exporting Your Google Chrome Extensions List

blocks.text: You can export a list of all Chrome extensions installed on Google Chrome in your organization and upload it to the Inventory in Zscaler 3rd-Party App Governance.
This method is supported if the Chrome browsers in your organization are cloud-managed. To export extensions as an admin:

blocks.item: Enroll your user’s browsers to be cloud-managed using an MDM software.
Generate a report of the installed extensions.
Click the Export button to export the report to a CSV file.

blocks.text: To export extensions as a user:

blocks.item: Open Google Chrome, and enter chrome://system/ into the address bar.
